claim: Descriptive headless frame intervals and main-thread render submission times for this spike; no comparative speed claim.

environment.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 6850U with Radeon Graphics
environment.renderer: ANGLE SwiftShader (software; forced by launch flags)
environment.concurrentWork: The shared preview browser and normal workstation processes were active. Load and core count are recorded; this run makes no hardware-GPU or comparative speed claim.

method.order: program → repetition → fly/ring/side; same queried data in each view; paused camera, live render loop
method.query: one worker evaluation per program; queryMs excludes worker startup/message/geometry. loadMs includes them.
method.draw: performance.now around controls.update + renderer.render + label projection; CPU submission, not GPU completion
method.frame: requestAnimationFrame interval; screenshot and query warmup excluded; no forced-fps flags
method.limits: 150k haps/sample window, 256 cycles, 8 second worker timeout; no speedup claim

checks.check: fast(64): 512 real onsets/cycle, explicit LOD aggregation
continuous values produce bands in addition to 48 genuine note onsets
time-addressed randomness is deterministic across new workers
range beginning inside long note gives continuations, zero duplicate onsets
identical stacked unison voices remain two haps
bare values retained without inventing notes or sounds
pasted multi-label program and explicit tempo evaluate
query errors show failure and clear prior data
60 CPM playhead follows elapsed time; fly camera advances 1.75 world units/cycle
mouse drag orbits and wheel zooms a real 3D camera
query horizon stops playback explicitly; no false loop or inferred repeat
390px touch viewport: orbit and two-finger pinch change camera
256-cycle window evaluates and fits in the coil (visual readability judged separately)
close zoom restores individual haps from auto LOD
density sweep: real queries at 16/32/64/128/256/512 onsets per cycle
